text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years since debuting in the Twinkle Series.
Cheval Grand has achieved remarkable results—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to gain a little confidence in myself.
...Or so I thought."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During the handshake event—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
I waited in line for 2 hours just to see you, Cheva-kun~♡
I'm so happy to meet you♡
I'll always be cheering for you♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-Thank you so much.
I-I'm really glad you came, t-too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her tendency to get nervous in front of crowds didn't seem to have changed much.

text_block_list.name: Timid Fan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I've... been cheering for you all this time...
............ Uh, umm...――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah... Th-Thank you...
............ Um, err...—

text_block_list.name: Timid Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Um!!
Please keep... d-doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer...
Everyone came all the way to see me, but
I completely messed up...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Do you think they're exasperated with me...?
Maybe I should apologize now while I can...
choice_data_list: It's okay. Everyone loves you just the way you are
It's okay. Everyone loves you just the way you are

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right. Instead of apologizing, I should tell them how happy I am...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even so, just like this, being able to recognize when she's falling into negative thinking shows clear signs of growth."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... S-So delicious...
choice_data_list: We talked a lot today, didn't we
We talked a lot today, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I'm so nervous... but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand speaks with a smile about how happy she was.
It seems she's genuinely enjoying her interactions with the fans in a positive way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And another way she had grown was—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, this shop...
Crown-san told me about it.
I've... always wanted to come here...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So... Trainer.
Thank you very much..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer,
e-even though it was my first time,
I was able to go in without being scared, so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because you've taken me to so many places up until now, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I don't think... there's anyone else.
No other Trainer would do that for me. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Is that so? I didn't think I did anything special enough to warrant gratitude. Just—
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to broaden your world.
Because I wanted to broaden your world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She tended to retreat into her shell,
and I had felt that I wanted to show her the outside world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That she can go wherever she wants without hesitation.
If even a fraction of that reached her, then being a Trainer has truly been worth it."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My... world...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer.
There's... something I've been thinking about lately...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-Someday...
It doesn't have to be right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still.
Someday, I'll—”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to... run in overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I won't say 'someone like me...' anymore.
All I have to do is work hard to live up to it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Until it comes true... I'll keep aiming for it.
Enduring, persevering, doing my best...
I think... maybe that's just the kind of—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I think... it's what I'm best at...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I... wanted to see
a wider world too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Is that... not okay...?
choice_data_list: Of course not! I'm totally for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I feel like heading straight back to the Trainer's office right now to draw up our travel plans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can't just leave her behind,
so I take her firmly by the hand instead.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wah, ah... T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her world will expand far across the distant seas.
I pictured such a dazzling future in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "I see, overseas...! Ahaha, then maybe one day, you'll come visit Australia too?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, well, I don't know
how much I can actually do, but...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
――Still, yeah.
I'll aim for it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A new promise.
Someday... we'll definitely meet on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah.
...You know, my rehab is going really well."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "Fufu, given my condition, to be perfectly honest, it's excruciatingly tough."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I'll do my best.
Holding the courage Cheval-chan gave me close to my heart."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "And then, I got super strong—"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Connected even across the seas,
cheers that reach the sky."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"I swear I'll make sure it reaches
Cheval-chan."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I, even I...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to you either. I'll become an even, even
more "magnificent Umamusume"—
